method: Visual triage of every variant drawing and all available primary source crops, with linked alternate specimens inspected where documented. Rectangles retain native aspect ratios; no photograph registration or numerical fidelity score is claimed. Generated colourways and missing-source packages are reviewed as evidence gaps, not specimen comparisons.

statusDefinitions.retain: Keep the current construction at this review level; not a claim of historical authentication.

statusDefinitions.interpretation: Generated colourway without a linked same-colour specimen.
